items.note: The plan states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection stages, the scratch-independent net change (JV+RG)x, the bit coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 and the three-stage map (x,y)->(-y,x), all matching lines 748-762. It omits h=100, the triple indexing with N and m, the eight-row schedule (only 'subtract-add-undo') and the wire counts, and it never gives the complex coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 (line 753), so the derivation covers only the bit case.

It states D_out S D_in^{-1}, the edge change D_vD_u^{-1} and the reason: a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate. This is the paper's invariant argument at lines 804-815. The route formula ε_w D_sink D_source^{-1} is only implied, through 'intermediate frames cancel along each route'.

It gives nondegenerate nested labels in an m-dimensional space, the only decreases (central wires from time 3 to 4, h each), Ic decreasing edges, Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, all correct. For the derivation it quotes the lemma's statement and the telescoping (line 1066-1071) but has no gate-label table, time ordering, residual table, or orthonormal bases over F_2 (lines 975-1102).

It has projection frames, the shear frame Φ_M, P_V-P_U of rank dim V-dim U, one extra rank per negative source projection, s=Wm-N+2L<Wm with deficit N-2L>0, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m. This follows the proof at lines 1156-1172.

It gives the phase frame, additivity of weight mod 4 over orthogonal vectors, one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per residual vector, s_c=Wm-2N+2L<Wm, and C^{⊗m} on every role after the corrections. The X_a->Y_a endpoint analysis (C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, removed by C=iZC^{-1}Z, lines 1290-1310) appears only as the outcome 'diagonal corrections', and the k-column tensoring is missing.

It states s<Wm for both networks, from L<N/2, and s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}. It omits the deficits η_b, η_c, the bound η>20·2^{-50} and the log m<20 argument (lines 1319-1338) that justify τ. S3.6 is a bare quote.

The four elementary operations and the controlled shift and unit scaling are stated, and the shift and scaling proofs (split at Q-a; c increasing pieces) match lines 577-603. The hypothesis that the offset is prepared in b^{O(1)} time, and the prime and denominator conditions, are missing. Lemma elementary-streams is given only as a quoted statement, with no derivation.

Both the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 and the cost (exactly rank A interchanges plus O(V)) are correctly stated. The shear proof follows lines 1425-1447. The factorization is only quoted, without the elimination proof of lines 1375-1392, and the choice of the fixed prime q is missing.

It has the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, the network with frames Φ_M giving H<-H+D on every row (scratch rows included), the three-shear interchange, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^τ), and the depth-first schedule at O(V) per node. This follows lines 1491-1584.

It has high digits interchanged to form a row field of range at least W^k, padding, base-m pieces handled by the power-width procedure that sum to O(Ve^τ), and padding to radix q giving O(Vu^τ). This is the paper's route.

It gives the conjugation by P_M with coordinate kernels, exactly s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, C^{⊗e} on every role, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. It omits the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f}C^{⊗f}Z^{⊗f} (line 1886), which keeps each child a forward call. It also omits the reduction of P_M to a fixed number of row additions (lines 1892-1901).

errors.paper: The second scaling multiplies by $2^{2b+4}S$, not $2^{2b+4}$ alone; the two occurrences of $S$ undo different normalizations (S9.5.6 and S9.5.8 have this right).

errors.says: seven dominant terms have powers of $p$ at most $1-2\kappa$ below one
errors.paper: Each of the seven powers is at most $1-2\kappa$, so each margin below one is at least $2\kappa$. The step's 'at most ... below one' muddles the direction of the margin.

errors.says: Only the bit-case coefficient $|S\cap T|\bmod2$ is given, while S3.1 claims the three-stage exchange for both networks.
errors.paper: In the complex case the central coefficient is $(|S\cap T|-1)/2$, cancelled by side wires for intersection zero or two; neighbours differ (even intersection).

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: frames and labels give s<Wm, then the bit interface and matrix shear give the interchange recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). The complex phase interface gives the layer recurrence, and these feed the synthetic transforms, resampling, chirp, CRT and the final error and time accounting. It thins out in three places. The exponent τ=1-2^{-50} is asserted without the η>20·2^{-50}, log m<20 argument. The scalar network omits h=100, N, m and the complex coefficient. The guard-width and packed-addition costs are cited rather than derived.

steps.note: The plan has the exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) built from 3-subset gates, with every scratch wire restored. It never gives h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples, N=C(h,3)^3 or m=h^3, so the defining quantities are missing (conservative verdict).

It has an invertible frame per vertex, D_vD_u^{-1} on edges, a common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the point that only edge changes cost work.

It has nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from tensor products of triple indicator lines, nested along every edge, with the only decreasing edges being central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h.
S3.4.1 gives rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and the S3.4 method adds one extra rank per negative source projection. Those are the N rank-one exceptions.
It has Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L, with L from Ic decreasing edges of loss h (L=Ich via the quote at line 1070), and s=Wm-N+2L for the bit network.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L>0 (and 2N-2L>0) give s<Wm.
It has the endpoint difference P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on every input role, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
It has A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, the shear costing exactly rank A interchanges plus O(V) (one interchange per pivot), and s recursive calls per node.

It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ) by the geometric sum. The reason τ works (η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20) is absent; S3.6 only quotes the conclusion.

central.summary: The plan rebuilds the saving chain from frames through labels, the rank-equals-dimension count, the budget, the strict deficit, the endpoint identity and the edge-as-recursive-calls mechanism, ending in the recurrence. Two parts are weak. The fixed network lacks its defining sizes (h=100, N, m=h^3). The exponent τ=1-2^{-50} is stated without the deficit estimate that justifies it.
